searched: I searched the Illinois EPA air notice list, news and trade press for the DeKalb Project Vector data center. One news article names natural gas generators and gives no rating, so it is staged as a new plant with capacity blank.

I read the Illinois EPA air permit records for the data center sites. I found final or draft permits for Compass at Hoffman Estates, Aligned at Elk Grove Village and Northlake, and CyrusOne at Aurora, summed their generators, and staged each as a new plant.
I searched the Illinois EPA notice list, news and trade press for Meta DeKalb, Microsoft Hoffman Estates and T5 Grayslake and found no generator document for any of them.
I searched news and trade press for gas generation at Monarch Rock Air, Hut 8 Project 4 and the Joliet Technology Center and found no generating unit named, so those stay on the watch list.
I checked the final permit for Broadwing Energy Center against GEM and found no differences.

monitor.plant_name: Monarch Rock Air data center campus (Rockford)
monitor.monitor_reason: The campus has power generation mentioned in state records, but no generating unit, fuel or size is named.
monitor.note: A Rock River Current article from June 2026, based on state incentive records, says Monarch Rock Air plans a multibuilding data center campus with associated power generation on Friday Road in Rockford. It is described as a 1,400 MW phased data center, which is the size of the campus and not of any generator. No source I found names gas engines or turbines. The 250 MW of gas engines mentioned in the earlier task list could not be confirmed, and a Caterpillar order for a site called Monarch belongs to a West Virginia campus. Other reports describe grid power from ComEd. I looked for an Illinois EPA air permit notice and found none. Not found: fuel, number of engines and generating capacity. Check again for an air permit application.

verifications.note: Names Monarch Rock Air, Friday Road, a 1,400 megawatt phased data center and associated power generation.

newplants.researcher_notes: The Illinois EPA published a draft construction permit and project summary in June 2024 for Compass Datacenters ORD I at 3333 Beverly Road in Hoffman Estates. The project summary says the company applied for 205 diesel emergency generators: 200 sets of 2,000 kWe and 5 sets of 1,250 kWe. That adds up to 400 MW plus 6.25 MW, or 406.25 MW. The point is the street address from the Census geocoder, so the location is marked approximate. I found no final permit in the Illinois EPA record, so the status is announced. A Data Center Dynamics headline says Compass has begun work on the campus at the former Sears headquarters, so a person should check whether construction is under way. Start year is not known. The owner is named as Compass Datacenters ORD I, LLC.

newplants.plant_name: Edged DeKalb Project Vector Data Center power station

verifications.note: A WTVO news article of Dec 2, 2025. Says Project Vector by Endeavor Energy's Edged platform would deploy TurboCell natural gas generators in DeKalb, with a City Council vote on Dec 8.

newplants.researcher_notes: A WTVO news article from December 2, 2025 says the DeKalb Planning and Zoning Commission backed Project Vector, a data center by the Edged platform of Endeavor Energy. The article says the site would deploy TurboCell natural gas generators to reduce reliance on the grid until ComEd finishes upgrades. The site is northeast of Keslinger Road and Route 23. The article gave a City Council vote date of December 8, 2025. I did not find a report in a source that passed checking of how the vote came out. I did not find a megawatt rating, a generator count or an air permit. I searched Illinois EPA air permit notices, DeKalb city records and news. The Illinois EPA notice list has no record for Edged or Endeavor. The point is on Keslinger Road near the named site and is only approximate. The owner is not entered because no source names a legal owner entity. Capacity is blank and the status is announced.
newplants.action: Create the Edged DeKalb Project Vector Data Center power station in DeKalb County, Illinois, with the unit row below and capacity left blank. Update the status and capacity when a permit or the council result is found.
